title: Add self-boot Hybrid Receiver, image-backed carrier runtime and artifact boundary

before.state: OHF had Native blind bundles, Glyph Calculus and MicroISA experiments, but no carrier-neutral self-boot receiver contract tying BOOT, local symbol semantics, deterministic receiver rules, an actual self-contained carrier PNG and accessible-memory navigation together.
before.evidence: Native isolation and low-level deterministic transport existed as separate experimental mechanisms.

after.state: Experimental origami.hybrid-receiver.r0 defines BOOT -> ROSETTA -> PROGRAM -> INDEX -> MEMORY -> VERIFICATION; the synthetic Hybrid carrier embeds that logical envelope into carrier.png, the PNG is deterministically self-decodable without a private semantic sidecar, and an image-backed runtime exposes bounded BOOT/LOOKUP/FOLLOW/TRACE/VERIFY/STOP operations.

invariants: Carrier-local symbols have no assumed global semantic meaning
Unknown symbols or transitions fail closed
Hybrid model-facing active context is bounded independently from total memory
The public carrier PNG is the runtime source; private source/envelope files are evaluator/debug evidence only
Carrier PNG identity is checked against model_packet.json before tool execution
PNG transport round-trip and model perceptual readability are separate claims
Carrier target <=500 KB is enforced at generation time
Preprocessing/index-build touched cost is recorded separately from selective per-query touched/exposed cost
Tlaloc may propose receiver candidates but Origami validates and stores promoted receiver artifacts
Current receiver remains REFERENCE_CANDIDATE until model-facing Hybrid evidence exists

tests.command: go test ./... && go vet ./... && make build
coverage: PNG -> glyph -> byte -> logical envelope self-decode
missing-key UNKNOWN without semantic global-scan fallback

impact.runtime_semantics: experimental receiver reference and image-backed Hybrid runtime added; existing Origami core semantics are not redefined
impact.ohf: Glyph Calculus and SAFE_MICRO_ISA are positioned as low-level Hybrid execution/transport substrates, not universal symbol semantics
impact.tlaloc: experimental receiver-distillation and OpenAI-compatible model/tool runner consume only the declared public Origami boundary/process interface
impact.tonal: composition proposal exists but lock pins remain unchanged until component promotion

notes: The Master Prompt is a universal bootstrap reference candidate. Carrier-specific decoding semantics belong inside BOOT/ROSETTA/PROGRAM. Deterministic PNG recovery is now implemented, but VLM BOOT/Rosetta readability and cross-model Hybrid correctness still require held-out external evidence.
